about_short_description.short_description: Phantom is a crypto wallet that facilitates the buying, trading, and storing of cryptocurrencies, including NFTs and tokens.

product.name: Phantom Wallet
product.description: A self-custodial, multichain wallet for buying, storing, sending, and managing cryptocurrencies, tokens, and NFTs across supported blockchain networks.

product.name: Phantom Trading
product.description: An in-wallet trading service for buying and selling supported cryptocurrencies, discovering tokens and traders, and accessing token-related applications.

product.name: Phantom Connect
product.description: A free SDK and wallet infrastructure service that lets applications add social sign-in, embedded wallets, and secure transaction signing.

product.name: Phantom Card
product.description: A prepaid Visa debit card connected to Phantom’s money-management features for spending through Visa, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

product.name: Phantom Prediction Markets
product.description: A prediction-market service that lets users trade contracts tied to outcomes of cultural and current events.

product.name: Phantom Perps
product.description: A perpetual-futures trading service that supports long and short positions on eligible crypto assets.
